title: House of Arqam bin Abi Arqam
categoryChain: House of Arqam bin Abi Arqam
introduction:
HOUSE OF ARQAM BIN ABI ARQAM

The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) used to gather along with some Muslims at the residence of Arqam bin Abi Arqam to hold secret feasts. This continued for four years. Then Allah ordered him:

The house of Arqam was on the edge of Koh-e-Safa and it was demolished. Arqam also migrated to Medina along with other immigrants (Muhajireen) and passed away in about 55 A.H. He is buried in Baqi.
